messages.subject: Remove scaffold chromsomes from methylRawList/methylDiff object
parts: Hi, as the title indicates, I found a lot of scaffold chromosomes (such as KI270755.1, MT) except the commonly used  1-22, x, y chromosomes existing in my methylRawList/methylDiff obj, I'd like to know how to remove them. Can anyone give me some advice?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Remove scaffold chromsomes from methylRawList/methylDiff object
parts: You can use %in% operator to filter a data frame like object based on column content. You need to create a vector of valid chromosome names and filter the methlyKit object using [] notation with %in% operator
